notes.title: 01.09.2020 Updates
notes.content:
Dear all,

It’s been amazing days since Eternal Battlefield released. We are all grateful to see that many feedbacks helped us to realize the amount of rewards, the ways of obtaining those rewards are too few and our matchmaking mechanism does not work as expected. 

In order to address these issues:

1.	Added ‘Fortune Eye’ which enables random number within a range to be tossed and multiplies the awarded amount after each battle.

2.	Players can now invite friends to join the game and both sides can win free coins/gems.

3.	Optimized matchmaking mechanism so it prioritizes players in the same grade so players could be well matched in strength.

4.	Spending coins to summon also have chance to get Super Rare Epic unit.

5.	Adjust the grade up requirements to ensure a better grade leveling experience.

6.	Added descriptions to clearly state only one epic unit will be recruited in a group.

7.	Enable gender modification in account profile page and fixed the issue that gender shows up as male in ranking and team.

8.	Fixed/optimized translation problems.

These are only one chunk of the coming up updates. New races, new heroes, new soldier types as well as social related features are on our roadmap too, please stay tuned and noted that we are eager to interact and communicate with our players and your feedbacks are very important to us. Thank you all very much and have a nice battle!

E-mail: eternalbattlefield@hjjuntuan.com
